name: Saudi E-Commerce & Last-Mile Delivery
description: A six-page analytical study of simulated orders, customers, sales, delivery performance, cancellations and returns.
question: How can an e-commerce business identify sales-quality and last-mile delivery bottlenecks?
approach: Model customer, product, order and order-item tables; validate transactions; calculate sales and delivery KPIs; compare growth, average order value and fulfillment performance.
insight: Order growth alone is not proof of stronger commercial performance. Compare delivered sales, average order value and late deliveries before recommending operational action.

name: Saudi Retail Profitability
description: Exploring discount exposure, product margins, sales channels and category concentration.
question: Which discount and category patterns may put gross margin under pressure?
approach: Clean and segment transactions by discount band, category and channel; compute revenue, estimated gross profit and margin measures.
insight: The case study estimated 32.93% margin for non-discounted transactions versus 18.94% for discounts above 10%: a 13.99 percentage-point difference, not a measured business saving.

name: UNICEF India · Child Health Indicators
description: India-only analysis of ARI care-seeking, ORS treatment, ITN use and immunization coverage using UNICEF source data.
question: What do India’s reported child-health indicators show, and how do reference years differ?
approach: Filter UNICEF Global Dataflow to India (IND), match six source indicator codes, retain the reporting year and compare historical observations.
insight: Latest selected values: ARI 56.1%, ORS 60.6%, child ITN use 4.4%, household ITN ownership 7.9% (2021); DTP3 and MCV2 95% (2025). Different reporting years must not be conflated.

name: Hashtag Effectiveness & Engagement
description: MBA research project investigating perceptions of hashtags, content formats and social media engagement.
question: How do respondents perceive hashtags and their influence on engagement?
approach: Organize and analyze 340 survey responses, summarize descriptive results and develop content-testing recommendations.
insight: Surveyed perceptions should be distinguished from observed campaign conversion or causal performance.

name: Saudi Energy Demand & Load
description: Exploratory patterns in daily energy demand across cities and sectors using synthetic data.
question: How does modeled energy demand vary by geography, sector and season?
approach: Aggregate daily simulated records, compare sector and city trends and visualize load patterns.
insight: Designed to demonstrate time-series exploration; synthetic observations are not official Saudi energy statistics.

name: Saudi Workforce & Labor Market
description: A simulated labor-market reporting case study on workforce patterns and vacancies.
question: Where does the modeled labor market indicate changes in workforce demand?
approach: Prepare labor-market measures and visualize employment, vacancy and demographic trends.
insight: Useful for demonstrating workforce analytics, not for estimating actual Saudi vacancies.

name: Saudi Tourism & Hospitality
description: Simulated tourism, visitor and accommodation performance reporting.
question: How do tourism and occupancy metrics vary across cities and time?
approach: Build month-by-city performance summaries and compare modeled demand and accommodation indicators.
insight: Illustrative reporting only; modeled visitor trends are not published tourism figures.

name: Saudi Real Estate Analytics
description: Analyzing simulated real-estate transactions and price patterns.
question: How do modeled property prices and transaction mix vary across segments?
approach: Group property transactions by location, type and period; create price and volume measures.
insight: Shows segmentation and market-reporting techniques using synthetic data.
